name: magbo-video
description: Vídeo institucional MAGBO Access Control - intro + outro Remotion

scripts.render:all: npm run render:intro && npm run render:demo1 && npm run render:demo2 && npm run render:demo3 && npm run render:outro
scripts.render:portfolio: remotion render Portfolio out/magbo-access-control.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=25 --pixel-format=yuv420p --x264-preset=veryslow --image-format=png --muted && remotion render Portfolio out/magbo-access-control.webm --codec=vp9 --crf=43 --image-format=png --muted && remotion still Portfolio out/magbo-access-control-poster.webp --frame=120 --image-format=webp
